Class Driver

java.lang.Object
Driver
public class Driver extends Object
Driver Purpose: Console front end for the Grand Line Registry. All user input passes through readInt / readLine so a mistyped value never crashes the program or the Scanner.

    • readInt

      private static int readInt(String prompt)
      Purpose: Reads a whole number, re-prompting until the user actually types one. Catching InputMismatchException here is what keeps a stray letter from throwing all the way out of main.
      Parameters:
      prompt - the text shown before each attempt
      Returns:
      the integer the user entered
